name: Codex Tools
author: fidzzcodex@codex.io
description: Node.js, Python & PHP runtime for Pterodactyl dengan browser automation (Puppeteer/Playwright/puppeteer-real-browser), auto-detect runtime dari startup command, webhook notifications, auto backup, web terminal, dan Cloudflare Tunnel support.

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description:
Command to run your application on server start.
Examples: node index.js / npm start / python3 main.py

variables.name: Enable Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description:
Enable Cloudflare Zero Trust Tunnel to expose your server port to the internet.
Set to true to enable. Requires CF_TOKEN to be set.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description:
Token from Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard > Networks > Tunnels.
Required if ENABLE_CF_TUNNEL is true. Keep this secret!

variables.name: User Upload Mode
variables.description:
Skip git clone and allow manual file upload via File Manager.
Set to true to enable manual upload mode.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal Access Token for private repositories.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description:
Git username for private repositories.
Leave blank for public repos.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Git branch to clone. Leave blank for default branch.

variables.name: Auto Update on Restart
variables.description: Auto git pull every time server restarts.

variables.name: Package Manager
variables.description:
Package manager for auto-install dependencies (Node.js only).
Options: npm, pnpm, yarn, bun

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description:
Git repository URL to auto-clone on startup.
Leave blank to skip.

variables.name: Enable Webhook Notifications
variables.description: Send notification when server starts.

variables.name: Webhook Custom Payload
variables.description: Custom JSON payload. Use {event}, {server}, {ip}, {time} as placeholders.

variables.name: Enable Auto Backup
variables.description:
Automatically backup files to .codex/backups folder.
Keeps last 5 backups.

variables.name: Backup Interval (Hours)
variables.description: How often to auto-backup, in hours.

variables.name: Enable Web Terminal
variables.description: Access terminal from browser without Pterodactyl panel, via ttyd.

variables.name: Web Terminal Port
variables.description: Port for web terminal access.

variables.name: Web Terminal Username
variables.description: Username buat login ke web terminal (basic auth).

variables.name: Web Terminal Password
variables.description: WAJIB DIGANTI sebelum expose ke publik. Password buat login ke web terminal.

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description:
Node.js version to use if STARTUP_CMD is a Node command.
Pre-installed: 18, 20, 22. Default: 22.

variables.name: Python Version
variables.description:
Python version to use if STARTUP_CMD is a Python command.
Pre-installed: 3.11, 3.12, 3.13. Default: 3.13.

variables.name: PHP Version
variables.description:
PHP version to use if STARTUP_CMD is a PHP command.
Pre-installed: 8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4. Default: 8.3.

variables.name: Headless Mode
variables.description:
true = browser jalan headless (hemat resource, tanpa Xvfb).
false = browser jalan headful lewat Xvfb (dianjurkan untuk puppeteer-real-browser / bypass Cloudflare, rendering lebih mirip browser asli).

variables.name: Live Stats Interval
variables.description: Interval (detik) buat nge-print ulang uptime/RAM/disk di console selama container jalan. Set 0 buat matiin.

variables.name: Process Manager (PM2)
variables.description: true = jalankan app Node.js kamu lewat PM2, auto-restart kalau crash tanpa restart seluruh container. Cuma berlaku kalau STARTUP_CMD diawali 'node '.

variables.name: App Port
variables.description: Port aplikasi kamu listen di dalamnya (misal Express server).
